Authoritative, audited figures.

Credits and deductions identified in fiscal 2010 that related to prior periods. In fiscal 2010, we decided to divest our dehydrated vegetable operations. In fiscal 2009, we completed the sale of the trading and merchandising operations and recognized an after-tax gain on the disposition of approximately $ 301 million. In the fourth quarter of fiscal 2009, we decided to sell certain small foodservice brands. The sale of these brands was completed in june 2009. We recognized after-tax impairment charges of $ 6 million in fiscal 2009, in anticipation of this divestiture. | Commercial Foods | 4,447 | 3,848 | 16% |
| Total | $12,426 | $11,248 | 11% |

Overall, our net sales increased $ 1.18 billion to $ 12.43 billion in fiscal 2009, reflecting improved pricing and mix in the consumer foods segment and increased pricing in the milling and specialty potato operations of the commercial foods segment, as well as an additional week in fiscal 2009. - **Commercial Foods (Fiscal 2008 Net Sales):** $3,848 million (Source: *CAG fiscal 2010 annual report (10-K), page 42*)
- **Total (Fiscal 2008 Net Sales):** $9,079 million (Source: *CAG fiscal 2010 annual report (10-K), page 42* - Note: This is the corrected value from the post-audit correction)

### Percentage of Fiscal 2008 Total Net Sales Due to Commercial Foods

To calculate the percentage of fiscal 2008 total net sales due to commercial foods:
